# EmojiSalon

> A web app for recoloring emoji. Pick any emoji, customize the color of each
> layer, and download your creation as SVG or PNG for personal or commercial
> use. Rendering is based on Twemoji SVG data.

Site: https://emojisalon.pages.dev
Source: https://github.com/rutopio/EmojiSalon
License: CC-BY 4.0 (graphics, via Twemoji) / MIT (code)

## What it does

EmojiSalon lets you treat an emoji like a coloring page. Select an emoji, and
each colored layer becomes individually editable. Change the colors to create
custom variations, then export the result.

Common uses:

- Custom or brand-matched emoji variations.
- Cross-cultural or region-specific redesigns.
- Accessibility: high-contrast or more distinguishable variants for users with
  color vision deficiencies or low vision (e.g. telling apart similar flag or
  heart emoji).

## How to use

1. Open the playground and pick an emoji from the picker.
2. Edit the color of each layer in the emoji.
3. Download the result as SVG or PNG. There is no account or login.

This is an interactive client-side tool, not an HTTP image API. Output is
generated in the browser; there is no URL endpoint that renders an emoji image
from query parameters.

## Pages

- [Home / playground](https://emojisalon.pages.dev/): Select and recolor emoji.
- [Showcase](https://emojisalon.pages.dev/showcase): Example custom emoji and use cases.
- [About](https://emojisalon.pages.dev/about): Background, accessibility notes, and credits.
